Junior Full-Stack Developer
ABOUT THE COMPANY
We build collaborative software for growing businesses.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Build and maintain full-stack features for customer-facing web applications.
Collaborate with designers and engineers to deliver reliable software.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Develop production applications using Django and React.
Administer Linux systems and troubleshoot common server issues.
Use PostgreSQL or MySQL databases for application data.
Deploy application workloads to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Use Git and GitHub for source control and team collaboration.
Build Docker containers and maintain REST APIs.
PREFERRED
Experience with Kubernetes and cloud deployment tools.
BENEFITS
Health insurance, paid vacation, and retirement contributions.
LOCATION: Remote within the United States.
SALARY: Competitive annual compensation.
